display_name: Encouragement of Aliyah and Return (Temporary Provision) Law, 5786-2026: the exemption of an immigrant's and a veteran returning resident's income from personal exertion, tax years 2026 to 2030 (ss 1-6)

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Hebrew from the Law is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated mechanically from line N of the deposited transcription, and in short runs checked by tools/hebcheck.py to occur verbatim in it. Hebrew from the Income Tax Ordinance is quoted only in NOTES.md, on lines tagged `-- ext:[TAG] |`.

source.authority: a transcription, from the page images, of Sefer HaChukim 3511 pp. 416-418 (PDF pp. 4-6 of 25_lsr_12235101.pdf, sha256 72244dba261c44d2818f80708fa2dece5d8b99f75e788f48e290942ff4734155), checked against the PDF's text layer by tools/transcheck.py; not an official copy. scope: Encoded: s 1 (immigrant, veteran returning resident, relative, qualifying income by its kind); s 2(a) (who, the period from 5 November 2025 to 31 December 2026, the tax years 2026 to 2030, the ceilings 600,000 / 1,000,000 / 1,000,000 / 350,000 / 150,000, the election), (b) (140,000 for income received from a relative), (c) (both kinds in one year), (d) (the 2026 pro rata), (e) (the day of first residence); s 3 (a non-resident entity's business income, no ceiling, with its proviso and exceptions (b)(1), (b)(2)); s 4 (the 75-day limit); s 6. Inert: s 5, ss 8 and 9 of the enacting chapter. Out of scope, taken as inputs: the Income Tax Ordinance's definitions (resident, chargeable income, personal exertion, other income, relative, material shareholder, transparent corporation, veteran returning resident); the Law of Return, the Absorption Basket Law and the Citizenship Law. Eight forks are named switches, declined by default and resolved by trying each concrete reading (F2-F9); a default declines only where the readings give the question different answers. See NOTES.md sections 1-5.

period_answered.text: tax years 2026 to 2030; income of any other year is not exempt (text decides)
period_answered.persons: an immigrant who first became an Israeli resident, or a veteran returning resident who became one, from 5 November 2025 to 31 December 2026 (s 2(a))

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source, and no independent test pass has been run. Every expected value in il36-tests.l4 was worked by hand from the Hebrew text before the module was run. The text was transcribed from page images because the PDF's text layer garbles digits and parentheses; the transcription is checked against that text layer only by word and number multisets, and by a reading of the three page images.

check.note: 9 modules; all 262 assertions are in il36-tests.l4 (those that are #ASSERT REFUSED, with BECAUSE where the message is checked, are among them). No warning-severity diagnostic. One assertion failed in an earlier run of the same session (the share of 2026 for a person with an elected adaptation year, expected to be refused on F4, was refused on F5): the resolution of declined readings was changed to name the first fork that surely splits, the expected value was not edited (NOTES.md sections 6-7).

forks.F1: Assumption, not a switch: `chargeable income apart from this Law's own exemption` is the input; ITO s 1's definition of "הכנסה חייבת" read literally would make the Law's own exemption remove the income from the class it exempts.
forks.F2: Switch. The exception in "הכנסה מזכה" for income attributed under s 62A: (A) it makes such income qualifying although a transparent corporation pays it; (B) it is a further exclusion and adds nothing. Default: declined.
forks.F3: Switch. s 2(b) replaces paragraphs (1) to (3), not (4): (A) 2030 income received from a relative has paragraph (4)'s 150,000; (B) 140,000. Default: declined.
forks.F4: Switch. ITO s 14(b)(1)'s elected adaptation year: (A) not residence for "while they were Israeli residents" and for the 2026 period of residence; (B) residence. Default: declined.
forks.F5: Switch. The unit of s 2(d)'s proportion: (A) days over 365; (B) months with a day of residence over 12. Default: declined.
forks.F6: Switch. s 2(c)'s total cap in 2026: (A) prorated under s 2(d); (B) as listed, 600,000. Default: declined.
forks.F7: Switch. s 3 has no "while they were residents": (A) the entity's income is exempt only if produced while the person was a resident; (B) whenever produced in 2026-2030. Default: declined.
forks.F8: Switch. Whether s 4 takes away s 3's exemption of an entity's income: (A) yes; (B) no. Default: declined.
forks.F9: Switch. s 4's "באחת מאותן השנים": (A) fewer than 75 days in either 2028 or 2029; (B) fewer than 75 in the year the person ceased to be a resident. Default: declined.
forks.F10: Text decides: s 4's "מיום תחילתן" claws back the exemption of every tax year from 2026.
forks.F11: Assumption: the day of ceasing is the first day of non-residence; one continuous span of residence.
forks.F12: Text decides: tax years the paragraphs do not list (2025, 2031 on) are not exempt, including 5 November to 31 December 2025.
forks.F13: Assumption: s 3's proviso is tested over the items supplied, of whatever year.
forks.F14: Text decides, shape the encoder's: the election is a part of each item's amount.
forks.F15: Assumption: the adaptation year runs from the arrival day to the day before its first anniversary.
forks.F16: Assumption: "income received from a relative" means the payer is a relative.
